beta1.text: mosquito-to-human transmission, per-capita form (= beta1_paper * m_ref)

beta2.text: human-to-mosquito transmission, per-capita form (= beta2_paper * n_ref)

delta.text: mosquito development (recruitment) rate from hatching to adult

gamma.text: rate of viraemia completion in humans (recovery)

immune.text: proportion of the human population immune at outbreak start (natural + vaccine-acquired; paper's baseline is 0.80)

lambda1.text: rate of symptom onset after infection (1/intrinsic incubation period)

lambda2.text: rate of viraemic onset in mosquitoes (1/extrinsic incubation period)

m_ref.text: total mosquito population (assumed twice the human population)

n_ref.text: total human population (UN World Population Prospects 2019)

omega.text: YF-induced death rate among symptomatic humans

phi.text: proportion of infections that become symptomatic (Johansson 2014)

y0.text: initial exposed mosquitoes (fitted by the paper; its value 150)

z0.text: initial infectious mosquitoes (fitted by the paper; its value 995)
